text:
Section: 🎓 General Admission Questions
Q: What courses are offered at SSIT, Bhat?
A: Computer Engineering; Computer Science & Engineering; Information Technology; Mechanical Engineering; Civil Engineering
Q: What is the eligibility for admission to B.E. programs?
A: Students must have passed 12th Science (Group A or A+B) with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. Admission is through ACPC (Admission Committee for Professional Courses), Gujarat.
Q: Is there a management quota?
A: Yes, limited seats are available under the management quota as per GTU and AICTE norms. Visit the admission office for details.
title: 🎓 General Admission Questions

text:
Section: 📅 Admission Process
Q: How can I apply for admission?
A: ACPC (Online registration at gujacpc.admissions.nic.in); Management Quota – Visit SSIT campus for guidance and form filling
Q: What documents are required at the time of admission?
A: 10th and 12th Marksheet; School Leaving Certificate (LC); GUJCET Score Card; ACPC Registration Slip; Aadhar Card student and father; Passport Size Photos (5 copies); Caste Certificate (If applicable)
title: 📅 Admission Process

text:
Section: 💰 Fees & Scholarships
Q: What is the fee structure?
A: Approx. fees for B.E. programs is 67200/- per year.
Q: Are there any scholarships available?
A: Government Scholarships (for SC/ST/OBC/EWS); Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY)
title: 💰 Fees & Scholarships

Section: 🏫 Campus & Facilities
Q: Does SSIT provide hostel facilities?
A: Yes, separate hostels for boys.
Q: What other facilities are available on campus?
A: Well-equipped labs; Digital classrooms; Library with 10,000+ books; Canteen; Bus facility; Sports ground

Section: 📍 Visitor Information
Q: Where is the campus located?
A: SSIT is located near Bhat circle, near to Agora Mall and SP Ring Road.
Q: Whom should I contact for admission queries?
A: Phone: +91-9408260607, +91-7043609281; Email: info@ssit.co.in; Website: www.ssit.ac.in; On-campus Admission Help Desk available Mon–Sat (10 AM – 5 PM)

Section: Why Choose SSIT, Bhat?
Points:
- Reputed Institute under Shree Swaminarayan Group, known for discipline, value-based education & academic excellence.
- Affiliated to Gujarat Technological University (GTU) and approved by AICTE.
- Experienced Faculty with industry and academic expertise.
- State-of-the-Art Infrastructure – Modern labs, digital classrooms, and updated curriculum.
- Holistic Development – Technical knowledge combined with moral and spiritual values.
- Training & Placement Cell – Regular campus drives, soft skills training, and career support.
- Peaceful Campus surrounded by greenery with spiritual ambiance near Swaminarayan Dham.
- Transport & Hostel Facility – College buses, girls/boys hostel with all modern amenities.
- Student-Centered Approach – Personal mentoring, seminars, industrial visits, and technical events.
title: Why Choose SSIT, Bhat?
